Beef Nachos
By: spiceblogger
Published: Thursday, February 9, 2012 - 5:08am

Ingredients




1/2 lb ground beef
1/2 onion
1 T olive oil
1 T MexiCajun Seasoning
1/2 cup shredded cheese
sliced jalapenos
tortilla chips
2 T sour cream, low fat
1 T pico de gallo

Preparation

1 Sautee onion in olive oil.  Add ground beef and seasoning and brown until completely cooked. 2 Spread layer of tortilla chips onto a baking sheet.  Scoop meat onto chips and top with cheese. Add jalapenos (according to taste).  Bake at 350 for about 8 minutes, or until cheese is completely melted.  Remove from oven and top with sour cream and pico de gallo.

About

Easy weeknight meal or party appetizer
